Text: Almighty and everlasting God, during the baptism of Christ in the River Jordan, the Holy Spirit rested upon Him. You then proclaimed that Jesus is Your beloved Son. [t] Each of your adopted children, like Him, is born of both water and Spirit. [*] Forever keep Your children within Your love and holy will
Changes: 2025-01-12 - Paul Prins: Retranslated to follow content guidelines.
